_comment: Post-§3 registration manifest for scripts/mcp_sandbox_transport_verify.py. Copy path to TRANSPORT_MANIFEST= env var after registering one server per transport in zeroshield.

streamable-http.notes: Register via MCPConnectorPanel or control API. Use a public MCP echo/canary endpoint or in-cluster stub. OAuth servers (e.g. Linear) require manual authorize before tools/list.

sse.notes: Legacy SSE transport. Same upstream allowlist rules as streamable-http; agent upstream_manager handles SSE framing.

websocket.notes: Register wss:// URL. After §3 lands, gateway must route via broker_send_rpc → sandbox ws_manager (no mcp_ws_adapter hot path).
